name: Vladyslav Yerko
description: Vladyslav Yerko: A Brief Biography Vladyslav Yerko (born 1962) is a world-renowned Ukrainian illustrator and graphic artist, widely celebrated for his intricate, fairy-tale aesthetics and technical precision. Key Highlights Signature Style: Known for incredibly detailed, layered illustrations that blend classical Renaissance influences with a surreal, magical atmosphere. Major Works: He gained international acclaim for his illustrations of Hans Christian Andersen’s The Snow Queen and the Ukrainian edition of the Harry Potter series, which J.K. Rowling famously praised as among the best worldwide. Awards: His work on The Snow Queen won the "Best Children’s Book" award in the USA (2002) and a 2005 Anderson House Foundation medal. Legacy: Yerko is considered a modern master of book design, often spending years on a single project to achieve his hallmark level of "microscopic" detail.
